name: rays-job-prep-package
description: AI-agent tools for a tech job search: resume + LinkedIn review, recruiter outreach with Sales Navigator, and a hiring-post monitor with email alerts.

plugins.name: resume-linkedin-review
plugins.description: Step 1: sharpen resume bullets and audit/update your LinkedIn, truthfully and with your approval. Outputs candidate-profile.md.

plugins.name: linkedin-recruiter-outreach
plugins.description: Step 2: find, enrich and draft personalized InMails to tech recruiters with LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Drafts only; you review and send.

plugins.name: hiring-monitor
plugins.description: Step 3: every ~6h, watch your target companies' job boards and hiring posts and email yourself matches with outreach ideas.
